content.title: About
content.content: Slim Fast nutritional powder is a ready‑to‑drink meal replacement that provides a balanced blend of protein, carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals. Designed for weight management and sustained energy, it easily dissolves in water or milk.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Slim Fast was first launched in the United States in the 1970s as part of a weight‑loss program.
The powder is available in several flavors, including chocolate, vanilla, and strawberry.
Each serving contains about 200 kcal, making it a convenient low‑calorie meal substitute.
The product has undergone clinical studies confirming its effectiveness when used as part of a diet plan.

items.title: Balanced nutrition
items.content: Provides essential macronutrients – protein, complex carbs, and a modest amount of fat – helping to keep you feeling full.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Fortified with B‑vitamins, vitamin C, iron, calcium, and other micronutrients important for metabolism.

items.title: Calorie control
items.content: Low‑calorie formula allows reduction of daily caloric intake without excessive hunger.

items.title: Convenient usage
items.content: Quickly dissolves in liquid, making it practical for busy lifestyles.

items.title: Supports muscle mass
items.content: Contains about 10 g of protein per serving, aiding muscle preservation during weight loss.

items.title: Allergy to ingredients
items.content: May contain dairy proteins, soy, or gluten – avoid if you have relevant allergies.

items.title: Low fiber content
items.content: The powder does not replace whole fruits and vegetables, so additional fiber intake is recommended.

items.title: Not suitable for prolonged exclusive use
items.content: Long‑term reliance on meal replacements alone can lead to nutrient deficiencies without proper monitoring.

items.title: Possible gastrointestinal discomfort
items.content: Some individuals may experience bloating or mild stomach upset when switching quickly to meal replacements.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix one serving (approximately 30 g) of powder with 250 ml of water, milk, or a plant‑based beverage. Stir until fully dissolved and consume immediately. For added flavor and fiber, you may blend in fruit or berries.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the lid tightly sealed to prevent moisture ingress. Refer to the expiration date on the packaging.
